title: DIALS 3.31.0 Benchmark
heading: DIALS 3.31.0 benchmark report
build_note: DIALS is the 3.31.0 release; dials.version reports it as DIALS 3.31.
note: dials.scale is run with its defaults, so no resolution cutoff is applied to any dataset. The headline resolution, CC½, completeness and multiplicity are therefore for all scaled data. The "suggested" columns give the same statistics at the resolution limit dials.merge suggests, where a fit of CC½ falls to 0.3. In all_results.csv, overall_* holds the uncut statistics and suggested_* the statistics at the suggested limit.
